title_en: I’d like to book a table.
goal_ko: 전화로 자리를 예약하고, 다른 시간을 묻고, 예약 이름을 말하기

expressions.en: I’d like to book a table for ___.

help.blank: I’d like to ___ a table for four.

expressions.pattern: ^(?:hi |hello )?(?:id like to|i would like to|can i|could i) (?:book a table|reserve a table|make a reservation) for (?<x>(?:one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve|[0-9]{1,2})(?: people)?)(?: (?:tonight|tomorrow|on (?:monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday|sunday)|this (?:monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday|sunday)))?(?: at (?:(?:one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve|[0-9]{1,2})(?: (?:oclock|thirty|fifteen|forty five|forty|twenty|ten|[0-5][0-9]))?(?: (?:am|pm|in the morning))?))?(?: please)?$
partial_patterns: ^i want (?:to book |to reserve )?a table(?: for (?:one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve|[0-9]{1,2})(?: people)?)?$

ok: I’d like to book a table for four.
could I make a reservation for two people tonight at seven
Can I reserve a table for 3 tomorrow please
I’d like to book a table for four at seven.
partial: I want a table for two

expressions.pattern: ^(?:do you have anything|is there anything|do you have a table|is there a table|are there any tables)(?: available| free)? (?:at|around) (?<x>(?:one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve|[0-9]{1,2})(?: (?:oclock|thirty|fifteen|forty five|forty|twenty|ten|[0-5][0-9]))?(?: (?:am|pm|in the morning))?|later|earlier)$

ok: Do you have anything at eight?
is there a table available at 7:30

expressions.accept_note: 이름은 별명이어도 돼요. 이름만 말하면 부분.

ok: Could you put it under Kim?
can you put it under Hyemin please

scene.en: Hello, Green Table. How can I help you?
Hi. I’d like to book a table for four at seven.
Do you have anything at eight?
Yes, we do. What name is it under?
Could you put it under Nubi?
